exposure: Place of delivery preceding last pregnancy
First ANC Visit during last pregnancy
Number of ANC visits during last pregnancy
cohort: A total of 282 mothers in Akordet, Eritrea, who gave birth within the two years preceding data collection were included in the study.
finding: Higher maternal and paternal education, prior facility delivery, and complications during the last pregnancy were associated with an increased likelihood of facility delivery, while higher birth order (4th-6th child) was associated with a decreased likelihood.
cross-section timing: Mothers were interviewed regarding their births within the 2 years preceding data collection.
